title: platform.print-job-queued.v1
description: A print job was enqueued to platform.print_jobs. Published at enqueue time, before any station has seen the job, so it carries only what enqueuing knows and says nothing about whether the job was ever printed.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the job was enqueued, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The print job's own identity. Also the value a station resolves through IPrintStationQueue.

branchId.description: The branch whose print station should drain it.

kind.description: What is being printed, for example label.garment_job or document.invoice.

format.description: The artefact's format, for example pdf. A free-text token supplied by the queueing module.

payloadReference.description: An opaque object-storage key naming the artefact. Never dereferenced by this event; a subscriber that needs the bytes streams them through the station route that re-authorises the request. Never logged and never returned to a caller who asks for anything but the bytes themselves.

printerHint.description: The printer name or profile the caller asked for, or null when the branch has only one.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
